commands: cargo test --locked --offline --manifest-path partitionline-broker/Cargo.toml --test metadata_quorum --test raft_replication --test raft_membership --test raft_election
contract: Three-node and five-node TCP metadata application keeps a committed topic visible after a minority restart and refuses a follower create.
Replication tests cover committed-prefix conflicts, minority partition, lost ack, truncation of an uncommitted suffix, stale terms, and snapshot catch-up.
Membership tests cover addition, removal, stale directory identity, and three/five voter fault restart. Election tests cover stale leader fencing and losing partitions.
limits: This close records the current-source constituent suites. It does not add a new replication implementation.
Not a production qualification. Native Kafka Fetch, FetchSnapshot, and KRaft compatibility stay on KL11-70.
Data partition placement, ISR, and replicated produce acknowledgments stay on KL11-16 through KL11-19.
No fastest-server claim and Suite HOLD is unchanged.
